_comment: Tucson, AZ MSA — Pima County, a single-county MSA. Ingested from the ChatGPT Work research workbook 2026-08-04 (batch 4). NOT YET IMPORTED. `expected_publish` is recorded only after the owner approves the projected split, so a later run re-asserts what was approved rather than whatever it happens to compute.
_envelope_comment: Derived from the MSA COUNTY LIST, not the observed venue bbox (Toledo precedent — the observed bbox is only a lower bound and would reject a legitimate future venue near the metro edge). Pima County is the whole MSA, so the envelope is exactly its OSM boundary bbox (relation/1832206) rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg. This is the cleanest envelope in the corpus: a single-county MSA has no L-shape and no spanned corner, so there is no rectangle-vs-polygon over-reach to record. The box is wide in longitude (2.9 deg) only because Pima itself runs west to the Cabeza Prieta refuge on the Yuma County line; that land is national wildlife refuge and Tohono O'odham Nation with essentially no venue population, so the width costs nothing. Nearest separate metros checked and correctly EXCLUDED: Phoenix (33.45) sits north of latMax 32.52, Sierra Vista (31.55,-110.30) sits east of lngMax -110.44, Nogales (31.34) sits south of latMin 31.42.
